interface.name: Interface
interface.description: Customize different aspects of the editor's interface.

EditorGridCustomization.name: Grid Customization
EditorGridCustomization.description: Customize the colors of the editor grid

scrolling.name: Scrolling
scrolling.description: How scrolling and zooming with your mouse feels in the editor.

fixes.name: Fixes
fixes.description: Different fixes that you'll likely want to keep on to improve the editing experience.

miscellaneous.name: Miscellaneous
miscellaneous.description: Stuff that just doesn't fit in any other category.

other-mods.name: Other Mods
other-mods.description: Changes Tinker can make to better integrate other mods with Tinker itself.

HideTriggerUI.name: Slider Hides Trigger UI
HideTriggerUI.description: Dragging any slider in any trigger hides the trigger UI.

ImprovedLinkControls.name: Improve Link Controls
ImprovedLinkControls.description: Fix the link control buttons being clickable when toggled off, also fixes the size.

LDMObjectCount.name: LDM Object Count
LDMObjectCount.description: Show the total objects marked as high detail next to the total object count.

LengthInEditor.name: Show Length In Editor
LengthInEditor.description: Show the levels' length in time in the top left corner.

LiveColors.name: Show Active Colors
LiveColors.description: Show the levels' currently active colors on the bottom of the screen.

MixedEditExtras.name: Mixed Exit Extra Toggles
MixedEditExtras.description: Color the Edit Extra toggles to signify that they are not the same across the selected objects.

PreviewObjectColors.name: Preview Object Colors
PreviewObjectColors.description: Preview a color channel on the object buttons in the build tab.

ReferenceImage.name: Show Reference Image Button
ReferenceImage.description: A button to import reference images into a level.

SlopeDirectionIndicators.name: Slope Direction Indicators
SlopeDirectionIndicators.description: Show the front and back of slopes when selected to assist with not inverting slopes.

ZoomText.name: Show Zoom Text
ZoomText.description: Show a label with your current zoom as you zoom.

DurationDrag.name: Draggable Duration Lines
DurationDrag.description: Drag on a duration line to change the duration without going into a trigger's edit menu.

MultiTextEdit.name: Edit Multiple Text Objects
MultiTextEdit.description: Edit multiple text objects at once.

ObjectSummary.name: Show Object Summary Button
ObjectSummary.description: Add a button in the level settings to view how many of each object there are.

OldColorTriggers.name: Old Color Trigger Textures
OldColorTriggers.description: See the old color trigger textures when looking at old levels.

AddToSectionCrashFix.name: Fix NaN/Infinity Object position crash
AddToSectionCrashFix.description: Fixes a vanilla crash when objects are positioned at NaN or Infinity.

FixAreaCorruption.name: Fix Area Trigger Corruption
FixAreaCorruption.description: Fixes a vanilla bug where area trigger state gets broken when using start positions.

CenteredObjectButtons.name: Center Object Buttons
CenteredObjectButtons.description: Make the object sprites on the buttons in the build tab actually centered.

EditorSliderFix.name: Fix Editor Slider Max Distance
EditorSliderFix.description: Fix the position slider not being based on level length.

EditorTouchFix.name: Fix Editor Touch
EditorTouchFix.description: Fix editor touch not working if you are dragging while pressing playtest.

FixToggleTriggerVisibility.name: Fix Toggle Trigger Visibility
FixToggleTriggerVisibility.description: Fix toggle trigger opacity being broken, not allowing them to be hidden properly.

FixLinkedTeleport.name: Fix Orange Linked Teleport Portal Behavior
FixLinkedTeleport.description: Fix orange linked teleport portals not behaving sane in the editor when rotated, scaled, edited, etc.

FixSlopeHitboxRender.name: Fix Slope Hitbox Rendering
FixSlopeHitboxRender.description: Fix slope hitboxes not rendering properly after rotating them.

NoTouchPasteStateFix.name: Fix No Touch after Paste State
NoTouchPasteStateFix.description: Fix No Touch not working after pasting state until reopening the editor.

StartPosBlendingFix.name: Fix Start Pos Blending
StartPosBlendingFix.description: Fix blending set before a start position via color triggers not working.

TransformFix.name: Fix Transform Control Touch
TransformFix.description: Fix touch issues with Transform and Scale controls.

FixIgnoreDamage.name: Fix Wave in Ignore Damage
FixIgnoreDamage.description: Fix wave sliding on slopes instead of clipping through them when ignore damage is enabled.

FixTextObjectBounds.name: Fix Text Object Transform
FixTextObjectBounds.description: Fix the transform bounds for text objects such that they are not always {0, 0}. Updates them properly when the text and/or kerning is changed.

ZoomGroundFix.name: Fix Ground Position when Zooming
ZoomGroundFix.description: Fix the ground position not properly updating when you zoom.

CopyObjectString.name: Copy Object String
CopyObjectString.description: Copy object string to clipboard when copying in the editor.

hIDe.name: Hide IDs in the Edit Level screen
hIDe.description: Hide IDs in Edit Level screen, hold shift to show them.

MusicCameraLock.name: Show Music Camera Lock Button
MusicCameraLock.description: Lock the camera to the music line when playback is active with a toggle.

PlaytestConfirmation.name: Show Playtest Confirmation Popup
PlaytestConfirmation.description: Show an alert asking if you want to playtest when you click the playtest button.

AlternateLassoLocation.name: Alternate Lasso Select Location
AlternateLassoLocation.description: Move the Lasso Select button to the bottom right.

AutoBuildHelper.name: Auto "Build Helper"
AutoBuildHelper.description: Add a toggle to automate the Build Helper tool. Copy and paste objects and/or place custom objects to automatically run Build Helper on them when the toggle is on.

show-on-pause.name: Show on Editor Pause
show-on-pause.description: Show the auto build helper toggle on editor pause rather than in the editor.

AwesomeModifierIcons.name: Reworked Modifier Block Icons
AwesomeModifierIcons.description: Rework the Modifier blocks (D/H/J/S/F) by adding icons for each of their actions instead of the letter.

solid-border.name: Solid Border
solid-border.description: Make the border of the blocks solid instead of dotted.

show-letter.name: Show Letters
show-letter.description: Show the letters instead of hiding them.

move-f-block.name: Move F block
move-f-block.description: Move the F block to be next to the other modifier blocks rather than separated by the force blocks.

CanvasRotate.name: Editor Rotation
CanvasRotate.description: Allows the editor to rotate freely. Either with right clicking and dragging, pinching, or with the Joystick. Also fixes panning while the editor is rotated during playtest.

rotate-slider-thumb.name: Rotate Slider Thumb
rotate-slider-thumb.description: Rotate the slider thumb according to the editor rotation, such that left and right always points left and right.

pinch-to-rotate.name: Pinch to Rotate
pinch-to-rotate.description: Allow pinching and rotating 2 fingers to rotate the editor.

align-modifier.name: Align Object Rotation Modifier
align-modifier.description: Align placed objects to your exact camera rotation when held.

reset-rotation-keybind.name: Reset Camera Rotation Keybind
reset-rotation-keybind.description: Reset editor rotation back to 0 degrees.

EditTools.name: Extra Edit Tab Tools
EditTools.description: Misc edit tools for the edit tab to make editing easier.

camera-to-object-keybind.name: Camera to Object Keybind
camera-to-object-keybind.description: Keybind to move the camera to the selected objects.

object-to-camera-keybind.name: Object to Camera Keybind
object-to-camera-keybind.description: Keybind to move selected objects to the center of the camera.

GridControl.name: Grid Controls
GridControl.description: Add buttons to change the grid size.

HideUI.name: Hide UI Button
HideUI.description: Add a button to hide the editor UI.

hide-all.name: Hide All
hide-all.description: Hide the playtest and pause buttons as well.

ImprovedControls.name: Improved Scale and Rotate Controls
ImprovedControls.description: Add snapping and position locking to scale and rotate controls.

scale-with-zoom.name: Keep Scale Controls scale with Zoom

ImprovedGroupView.name: Improved Group Views
ImprovedGroupView.description: Show more than 20 groups at once in any group view, shows as a scrollable list of the groups.

left-align.name: Left Align Groups
left-align.description: Align groups to the left like vanilla GD.

JoystickNavigation.name: Joystick Navigation Control
JoystickNavigation.description: Navigate the editor with a Joystick. Most useful for mobile one handed use.

speed.name: Joystick Speed Multiplier
speed.description: The speed the editor will move at when the joystick is moved.

lock-position.name: Lock Position
lock-position.description: Lock the Controller's position where you left it last.

reset-position.description: Reset the Controller's position to default.

NegateInput.name: Negate Text Inputs
NegateInput.description: Press N and/or a button to negate any number input when focused.

always-show-negate-button.name: Always Show Negate Button
always-show-negate-button.description: Don't hide the negate button when a text input is not focused.

ObjectSearch.name: Object Search
ObjectSearch.description: Look up objects by name. Adds an all objects tab with search.

keybind.name: Jump to Search Keybind
keybind.description: Keybind to go to the search tab.

ObjectTooltips.name: Object Tooltips
ObjectTooltips.description: Show tooltips with object names when hovering over an object in the build tab.

show-object-id.name: Show Object IDs
show-object-id.description: Show object IDs on the tooltips under the name.

RelocateBuildTools.name: Relocate Build Tools
RelocateBuildTools.description: Relocate the build tools from the editor pause menu to the edit menu.

icons.name: Icons
icons.description: Icons for the Build Tools Buttons.

RepeatingEditorButtons.name: Repeating Buttons
RepeatingEditorButtons.description: Hold certain buttons in the editor to repeatedly press them.

ScrollableObjects.name: Scrollable Toolbar
ScrollableObjects.description: Scroll through editor tabs instead of navigating per page.

speed-modifier-key.name: Toolbar Scroll Speed Modifier
speed-modifier-key.description: Key to hold to speed up scrolling the editor tab.

speed-modifier.name: Speed Multiplier
speed-modifier.description: Scroll speed multiplier when modifier key is held.

invert-scroll.name: Invert Scroll
invert-scroll.description: Invert the direction scrolling on the tab goes.

scrollbar-height.name: Scrollbar Height
scrollbar-height.description: The height the scrollbar at the bottom of the tab is.

y-offset.name: Tab Y Offset
y-offset.description: The Y offset of the whole tab.

SingleDeselect.name: Single Deselect
SingleDeselect.description: Hold a modifier to deselect objects within an existing selection.

key.name: Object Deselect Modifier
key.description: Key to hold click to deselect.

StartPosTools.name: Start Position Switcher
StartPosTools.description: Start from and switch between any start position in the editor.

start-pos-switcher.name: Start Pos Switcher
start-pos-switcher.description: Navigate through every start pos in the editor.

skip-disabled.name: Skip Disabled Start Positions in Switcher
skip-disabled.description: Only be able to switch to start positions that are enabled.

auto-hide-switcher.name: Auto Hide Switcher
auto-hide-switcher.description: Hide the switcher when not being used.

hide-no-start-pos-button.name: Hide Playtest without Start Pos button

ThatPasteButton.name: Paste Warnings
ThatPasteButton.description: Show warnings for paste state and paste color.

toggle-paste-state-group.name: Show Paste State Warning on Edit Group popup

dont-show-if-default.name: Don't show warning if objects are default
dont-show-if-default.description: Don't show the warning when selected objects have no groups and use default colors.

object-requirement.name: Number of Objects to Show Warning
object-requirement.description: The amount of selected objects needed for the warning to pop up.

UIScaling.name: UI Scaling
UIScaling.description: How large elements in the UI are. BetterEdit's scale factor will override this if being used.

scale-toolbar.name: Scale Toolbar
scale-toolbar.description: Scale the toolbar (create, edit, and delete tabs) with the rest of the UI.

use-safe-area.name: Use Safe Area
use-safe-area.description: Use the devices safe area when positioning to prevent camera cutouts and notches from overlapping UI elements.

use-custom-safe-area.name: Enable Custom Safe Area
use-custom-safe-area.description: Enable a custom safe area, aka the distance that is padded on the left and right.

custom-safe-area.name: Custom Safe Area
custom-safe-area.description: Set a custom safe area, aka the distance that is padded on the left and right.

QuickExtras.name: Quick Edit Extras Button
QuickExtras.description: A shortcut button to edit extra properties of objects, replaces Edit Special when it isn't needed.

always-show.name: Always show Edit Extras button
always-show.description: Make the Edit Extras button always visible instead of replacing Edit Special.

smooth-scroll-enabled.name: Enable Smooth Scroll
smooth-scroll-enabled.description: Make scrolling and zooming in the editor smoother.

zoom-to-cursor.name: Enable Zoom to Cursor
zoom-to-cursor.description: Make scroll wheel zooming based on the cursor position.

zoom-minimum.name: Minimum Scroll Zoom
zoom-minimum.description: How far you can zoom out when scrolling.

zoom-maximum.name: Maximum Scroll Zoom
zoom-maximum.description: How far you can zoom in when scrolling.

scroll-delegate-to-vanilla.name: Delegate Custom Scroll to Vanilla
scroll-delegate-to-vanilla.description: Pass the scroll parameters to the vanilla EditorUI::scrollWheel method. This can help with compatibility with DevTools, but will yield issues with other mods that change scroll.

invert-vertical-scroll.name: Invert Vertical Scroll
invert-vertical-scroll.description: Scroll wheel goes the opposite direction vertically.

invert-horizontal-scroll.name: Invert Horizontal Scroll
invert-horizontal-scroll.description: Scroll wheel goes the opposite direction horizontally.

invert-zoom-scroll.name: Invert Zoom Scroll
invert-zoom-scroll.description: Scroll wheel zooming goes the opposite direction.

stop-swipe-on-shift-release.name: Stop Swipe on Shift Release
stop-swipe-on-shift-release.description: Stops swiping when shift is released before clicking is released.

EditorGridCustomization-grid-invert.name: Grid Inverts Behind
EditorGridCustomization-grid-invert.description: Make the grid invert the color behind it rather than a static color. (Overrides Grid Color setting)

EditorGridCustomization-grid-invert-opac.name: Grid Invert Opacity
EditorGridCustomization-grid-invert-opac.description: The opacity of the grid when using invert

EditorGridCustomization-color-effect-lin.name: Color Effect Lines by Trigger Color

Keybinds-restart-from-beginning.name: Playtest Restart without Start Positions
Keybinds-restart-from-beginning.description: Restart level from beginning, ignoring start positions. Only works with Start Pos Tools enabled.

Debug-module-logs.name: Module Logs
Debug-module-logs.description: Show Module Created, Destroyed, and Toggled logs
